title: large-tty
caption: Large Type in Your Terminal
description: large-tty is a small project that turns whatever you type into big ASCII art, like large-type.com, but built for the terminal and the web.

It started as a Bubble Tea TUI and now also runs over SSH, so you can connect and use it directly from your terminal with ssh, or access it through the web w/ HTTPS. The terminal app is built in Go with Bubble Tea, Bubbles, Lip Gloss, Wish, and go-figure. The web app is built with React, TanStack Start, TanStack Router, and Tailwind CSS.
seoDescription: large-tty is a Go and React app that renders large ASCII text in your terminal, over SSH, and on the web with multiple fonts and auto-fit sizing.
